name: 直播带货脚本
description: 从商品资料写出一个商品的直播讲解：流程表（留人 → 痛点 → 塑品演示 → 信任 → 价格 → 逼单 → 返场）→ 逐段话术和弹幕问答（并行）→ 按《网络直播营销管理办法》和《广告法》检查。 / Write the live-stream pitch for one product: rundown (hook → pain → value demo → trust → price → close → recap) → segment script and chat Q&A (in parallel) → checks based on China's live-stream marketing rules and Advertising Law.

price.description: 直播价和优惠，例如：直播间 99 元，前 100 单送杯套 / Stream price and offer

minutes.description: 这个商品讲几分钟 / Minutes for this product

host.description: 主播风格，例如：亲切的邻家姐姐、专业测评 / The host's style

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 商品资料
stages.description: 商品的真实参数和售后。话术里每个说法都要在这里找得到。 / The product's real specs and after-sales terms. Every claim in the script must be found here.

executor.instructions: 把 materials/product.md 换成你的商品资料。示例是虚构的榨汁杯。 / Replace materials/product.md with your product's facts. The sample is a fictional blender cup.

stages.name: 流程表
stages.description: 把时间分成留人、痛点、塑品演示、信任、价格、逼单、返场几段，每段有类型、分钟数和目标。 / Split the time into hook, pain point, value demo, trust, price, close and recap, each with a type, minutes and a goal.

stages.name: 话术
stages.description: 逐段写主播的话术、动作和互动；逼单段分别对新进来的、看了没下单的、已经下单的人说。 / Write the host's lines, actions and chat prompts per segment; the close speaks separately to newcomers, viewers who have not bought, and buyers.

stages.name: 弹幕问答
stages.description: 观众最常在弹幕里问的问题和一句话回答，和话术并行。 / The questions viewers ask most in chat, with one-line answers, in parallel with the script.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 分钟数、段落类型、价格是否说出；《网络直播营销管理办法》第十八条的虚构数据和误导信息、《广告法》的绝对化和医疗用语、价格比较，以及资料里找不到的数字。 / Minutes, segment types, whether the price is stated; invented data and misleading claims (live-stream marketing rules art. 18), absolute and medical terms (Advertising Law), price comparisons, and numbers the facts do not contain.
